lead_raw_text:
The structure of La6Ni2O14 (reduced formula La3NiO7) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ni centers coordinated by six O neighbors in an octahedral motif, while La centers adopt 8- and 10-vertex coordination environments with O neighbors; the O centers bridge one or two La centers. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ni octahedra, and corner-sharing between Ni octahedra and La 8- and 10-vertex polyhedra.
